pussellawa-kids-trip.title: Pussellawa kids' trip to Hanuman Kovil
pussellawa-kids-trip.quote: The children truly enjoyed the experience and were very happy.

expectations.text: Every child travels safely there and back
expectations.note: The hired vehicle took the group to Hanuman Kovil and home again.

expectations.text: All the children share a good meal together
expectations.note: Food for the whole group was covered (Rs 8,750).

expectations.text: The day is recorded in photos and short videos, with permission, to share the joy
expectations.note: Photos and videos of the day were sent by the organisers.

updates.title: A happy day at Hanuman Kovil
updates.body: The children spent the day at Hanuman Kovil: games on the lawn, dancing and a meal together. The organisers wrote to thank everyone: the children truly enjoyed it and were very happy.

updates.title: Fully funded
updates.body: The full cost of Rs 19,250 is covered: Rs 10,500 for the vehicle and Rs 8,750 for food. Thank you to everyone who gave.

maha-arivagam-preschool-day.title: Maha Arivagam pre-school trip to the Black Bridge
maha-arivagam-preschool-day.quote: The happiness on the children's faces is the greatest gift we received.

budget.item: The day out for the pre-school children

expectations.text: Every child travels safely there and back
expectations.note: The bus left the pre-school at 3.30 and everyone was back by 6.00.

expectations.text: The children play, laugh and eat together
expectations.note: Ice cream at the bridge, dancing, playing in the river and snacks at the temple.

expectations.text: The day is recorded in photos and short videos, with permission, to share the joy
expectations.note: Photos, videos and a before and after note were sent by the pre-school.

updates.title: Ice cream, the river and the temple
updates.body: Seventeen children, 20 parents and two teachers went to the Black Bridge over the Pali Aru and to Banalingeswaram temple. The children danced, played in the river and saw the sculptures of the 64 Nayanmars. The manager wrote: the happiness on the children's faces is the greatest gift we received.

updates.title: Fully funded
updates.body: The full cost of Rs 20,000.00 is covered. The pre-school thanked Raavanaa and everyone who helped.

casuarina-beach-day.title: Kids' day out at Casuarina Beach

budget.item: Van hire to Karainagar and back

expectations.text: Every child spends time in the sea, safely, with a volunteer close by
All 25 children share a good lunch together
Each child goes home with a small gift and a day to remember

mums-and-kids-day-out.title: Mums and kids, united: a day out together

budget.item: Printed family photo for each mum

expectations.text: Mums get a full day off, with nothing to do but enjoy their children
expectations.note: No cooking or chores: lunch was served for everyone.

expectations.text: Every mum and child plays at least one game together
expectations.note: Sack races and a tug of war, mums against kids.

expectations.text: Each family takes home a photo of the day
expectations.note: 18 printed photos handed out before the bus left.

updates.title: A day the mums said they will never forget
updates.body: Eighteen mums and thirty children spent the day together: sack races, a tug of war the mums won, and a long lunch in the shade. For many mums it was the first day in years with no work to do, only time with their children. Every family went home with a printed photo of the day.

budget.item: Bus to the arcade and back

bowling-day.title: A bowling day out for the Sivapoomi kids

pussellawa-kandy-trip.title: A day in Kandy for the pupils of Pussellawa
pussellawa-kandy-trip.quote: These students have never been anywhere on an excursion.

budget.item: Bus to Kandy and back (about 50 km each way)

expectations.text: Every child travels safely to Kandy and back
The whole group shares a good meal together
The children visit the Temple of the Tooth and the Peradeniya gardens

updates.title: New date: 27 November
updates.body: The trip to Kandy has moved to Friday 27 November 2026. Everything else stays the same: the Temple of the Tooth, the Peradeniya gardens and Rs 61,000 for the bus and food.

updates.title: The plan is ready
updates.body: The day is set for 27 November 2026: the Temple of the Tooth in Kandy, then the Peradeniya gardens. The cost is Rs 61,000 for the bus and food, and the school has permission from the Department of Education.
